name: acoustic_grand_piano
label: Acoustic Grand Piano
description: A full-sized concert grand piano with rich, resonant tones across the entire range. Features the characteristic hammer strikes and string resonance.

name: bright_acoustic_piano
label: Bright Acoustic Piano
description: An acoustic piano with a brighter, more percussive attack. Emphasizes the higher harmonics for a more cutting tone.

name: electric_grand_piano
label: Electric Grand Piano
description: An electronically amplified grand piano with a slightly processed, warm tone. Less resonance than acoustic.

name: honkytonk_piano
label: Honky Tonk Piano
description: A slightly detuned piano with a nostalgic, ragtime character. Evokes saloon and honky-tonk music from the early 20th century.

name: electric_piano_1
label: Electric Piano 1
description: A Rhodes-style electric piano with warm, mellow tones. Features bell-like overtones characteristic of tines striking pickups.

name: electric_piano_2
label: Electric Piano 2
description: A Yamaha CP-style electric piano with a brighter, more metallic tone. Popular in 1970s and 1980s music.

name: harpsichord
label: Harpsichord
description: A plucked keyboard instrument from the Baroque era. Features bright, crisp articulation with minimal sustain.

name: clavinet
label: Clavinet
description: An electric keyboard with percussive, clav-like tone. Often used with wah-wah effects in funk and rock music.

name: celesta
label: Celesta
description: A keyboard instrument with a delicate, bell-like tone. Produces ethereal, crystalline sounds perfect for magical or celestial effects.

name: glockenspiel
label: Glockenspiel
description: A percussion instrument with metal bars struck by mallets. Produces bright, shimmering tones similar to small bells.

name: music_box
label: Music Box
description: A mechanical music box with a tinny, nostalgic sound. Features a gentle, whimsical character.

name: vibraphone
label: Vibraphone
description: A percussion instrument with metal bars and motorized vibraslats underneath. Creates a warm, pulsating tone with natural vibrato.

name: marimba
label: Marimba
description: A wooden bar percussion instrument with resonators underneath. Features warm, mellow tones across a wide range.

name: xylophone
label: Xylophone
description: A wooden bar percussion instrument with a bright, dry tone. Similar to marimba but with less resonance.

name: tubular_bells
label: Tubular Bells
description: Tuned metal tubes struck by mallets. Creates clear, bell-like tones that ring and sustain. Famous from horror films.

name: dulcimer
label: Dulcimer
description: A stringed percussion instrument played with hammers. Produces sweet, gentle, resonant tones.

name: drawbar_organ
label: Drawbar Organ
description: An electronic organ with drawbars controlling harmonic content. Classic B3-style organ with pipes and percussion controls.

name: percussive_organ
label: Percussive Organ
description: An electronic organ with percussive attack and fast decay. Often used with treble registration for bright passages.

name: rock_organ
label: Rock Organ
description: An organ with a driving, energetic character. Combines depth with percussive attack for powerful rock sound.

name: church_organ
label: Church Organ
description: A traditional pipe organ with full, majestic tones. Creates solemn, reverent, expansive soundscapes.

name: reed_organ
label: Reed Organ
description: A wind-driven keyboard instrument with reeds. Creates warm, vintage, slightly breathy tones.

name: accordion
label: Accordion
description: A handheld bellows-driven keyboard. Produces warm, cheerful, slightly nasal tones associated with European folk music.

name: harmonica
label: Harmonica
description: A wind instrument with reeds. Produces warm, bluesy, expressive tones. Can be played with characteristic bends.

name: tango_accordion
label: Tango Accordion
description: An accordion with a darker, moodier character. Features the passionate, sultry tone of traditional tango music.

name: acoustic_guitar_nylon

description: A classical acoustic guitar with nylon strings. Produces warm, mellow, resonant tones with natural finger-picked character.

name: acoustic_guitar_steel
label: Acoustic Guitar - Steel String

name: electric_guitar_jazz

name: electric_guitar_clean

name: electric_guitar_muted

name: overdriven_guitar

name: distortion_guitar

name: guitar_harmonics

name: acoustic_bass

name: electric_bass_finger

name: electric_bass_pick

name: fretless_bass

name: slap_bass_1

name: slap_bass_2
label: Slap Bass 2

name: synth_bass_1

name: synth_bass_2

name: violin

name: viola

name: cello

name: contrabass

name: tremolo_strings

name: pizzicato_strings

name: orchestral_harp

name: timpani
